## Strip polish

- Native strip tiles show the window label only (Weekly / 5h) and optional reset. Long account names no longer collide with the next provider; seat identity lives in the flyout via **On strip** and the account line.
- Flyout **On strip** chip is smaller and quieter; banked-resets chip is slightly larger so the hierarchy is clear.

## Also in this line (since 1.5.6)

- Pin which Codex or Claude seat drives each strip tile (Settings > Taskbar). Flyout marks that account **On strip** and lists it first.
- Charts: **N% of tokens priced** when unpriced models shrink dollar totals; Grok multi-project/partial session usage; **Quota run efficiency** card (tokens per 1% used, cache-read share, projected tokens at 100%, run-over-run change). Local observation only.

## Installers

- **Ceiling-1.5.8-Setup.exe** - standard installer
- **Ceiling-1.5.8-portable.exe** - portable
- **Ceiling-1.5.8-Store-Setup.exe** - Microsoft Store package (WebView2 bundled)
